scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Arm (Minor)
Crunchy And Tasty

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your foe ferociously latches on to your lower arm, twisting and pulling until there is a distinct crack as your wrist snaps.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (1). You must also pass a Challenging (+0) Strength Test or go @Condition[Prone]. You suffer a Broken Bone (Minor).
